Around [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]] undertook a '''mission''' to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to save their former master, [[Yuon Par]], from the [[Dark Plague]], using the [[shielding technique]] learned from the [[Noetikon]]s.
